title: Function Failedactivedirectorylogons
author: reprise99
description: Save as a function in your workspace then invoke via its name, i.e if you save as ADFailedLogons ADFailedLogons | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | where Account == "DOMAIN\username" // will find logon failures by that user ADFailedLogons | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | where ResultReason == "User logon with expired password" // will find logon failures from accounts with expired passwords This will parse the SecurityEvent log for logon failures and add the descriptive reason.
